title: twoTerminalOperatingPoint
description: Operating point template for two-terminal components (capacitors, resistors, two-terminal diodes). One excitation (single voltage and current waveform) plus the shared operatingConditions. Multi-port components (transformers, three-terminal switches) use multiPortOperatingPoint.json instead.

excitation.title: operatingPointExcitation
excitation.description: Voltage and current waveforms across the two terminals. Uses the standard operatingPointExcitation type (mirror of MAS). For two-terminal components the magnetic-field properties are not used; the (frequency + current + voltage) branch of the anyOf applies.
